measurement_caveats: Only the selector differs between these two new arms. Both use 3M executions, 400M frames, 4 workers, 8 GiB, 4096 actions, alphabet_only, one_to_six, and seeds 3/4/5.
The historical prototype had another improvement-replay queue; these arms do not reproduce it. The 005 panel used different budgets, worker counts, suffix and mixture.

Each arm ran three simultaneous jobs on disjoint CPU sets of a heterogeneous 24-core CPU. Development builds and replay qualification overlapped. FPS/wall-time differences are not causal selector throughput comparisons.

Build 008 uses reporting v1, predating Mother Brain/escape fields and the root route-clock correction. Those fields are unavailable across its explored branches. Milestone action timestamps use route frames; replay-origin frame stamps in this old bundle must not be interpreted as route frames.
All first-discovery inputs are replayed twice by the original frozen binary. A union across branches is not one complete playthrough.
Disk covers cell output directories only. Shared assets/builds and runtime temporary files elsewhere are excluded.

Every completed-run discovery/champion tape was subsequently replayed twice on build 010, source commit 8a9dcbbe. Those trajectory-only outputs correct route stamps and add Mother Brain/escape fields; they do not reconstruct uncaptured whole-search observations.
purpose: Development diagnostic of historical-depth mismatch; not a fresh unseen-seed validation or exact historical-algorithm reproduction.
